question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9396616dfb2510b24b78bc9650b0eacafb7bb42e43c3d4341aa9f2459d9a718.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For rectangle element - No change.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dcf5941857fb7ebf1584885c28e664deec98076e6b2317110c77dca73e01c567.png] 

2) For circle element - Shifting in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd950e9196972868598af4787233bb77f1b528e1d382939c616c7e9b0afb9010.png] 

3) For '#' element - Shifting in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2401c2a9c6a34dff2801d40deeea541321caf08362127f6f247f7167ef25856f.png] 

Final series is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04ea85915864446e2751aa01699c8905538f0af96215764f6ad94cf337d933ef.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (1)’ is the correct answer.
